name: com.fansfera/fansfera
title: Fansfera: niche sports sponsorship
description: Find niche sports venues to sponsor worldwide, panel price references, and request quotes.

tools.name: search_venues
tools.description: Search companies (venues, chains, organisers) in niche sports where a brand can request sponsorship. Sports keys: kart=karting, surf=surf park / wave pool, padel=padel, beach=beach tennis, escalada=indoor climbing, trampolim=trampoline park, tunel=indoor skydiving, wake=wakeboard cable park, mergulho=scuba diving, neve=skiing and snow, hipismo=equestrian, rafting=rafting, volei=beach volleyball, kite=kitesurfing, vela=sailing. Countries use ISO codes (BR, US, ES...).

tools.name: venue_details
tools.description: Public details of one venue, the sponsorship formats that can be requested and the country price reference (not the company price).

tools.name: sports_and_countries
tools.description: How many companies are listed per sport and per country.

tools.name: price_reference
tools.description: Monthly reference (US$) of a printed and a digital panel in a country, with how it was obtained. Not a quote.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send a free quote request to Fansfera for one or more venues. Before calling, show the user the venues and their own data and get explicit confirmation. No payment is made.

confirmed_by_user.description: true only after the user explicitly confirmed
